type: initial blind fresh independent whole audit of DG1 and DG2
recommendation: DG1 and conditional DG2 pass this audit, with the candidate's full-tiling, positive-margin and buffer restrictions. Coordinator promotion requires both independent audits.
clarifications_reconstructed_without_new: A tiled zonogon is a nondegenerate two-dimensional polygon; empty direction classes may be omitted while retaining two-dimensionality.
Every exterior radial sector attaches to one boundary-vertex cell, and every unbounded dual edge is the existing corresponding boundary edge.
Same-color sign sets are nested by their common two opposite-side corner cells; zero coordinate difference means no crossing of that color.
The exact DG2 constant is M_V(K ell+3E); Vc=0 and kappa ell>=2E are essential and stated.
Vertex choice adds a fixed tile-scale error; a whole-segment buffer of at least the proved band width is required for confinement.
The sqrt(epsilon)L conclusion fixes kappa,K and the affine-error constant before choosing small epsilon and a sufficiently large L.
outside_scope_open_obligations: Compatible closed side boundaries and corner rank offsets
EAI, profile recovery, H and the full 2017 problem
